Global chip trade slowdown seen as positive for Indian markets

A slowdown in the global semiconductor trade is being viewed positively for Indian stock markets. Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) are reportedly remaining optimistic about the Indian market, despite acknowledging potential risks. This trend suggests an increased appeal for India's market amidst global economic shifts in the technology sector.
